examples.text: In some cultures, it is acceptable for an uncle to marry his niece.

examples.text: He was eager to marry his daughter to a nobleman.

glosses: To unite in wedlock or matrimony; to perform the ceremony of joining spouses; to bring about a marital union according to the laws or customs of a place.

examples.text: A justice of the peace will marry Jones and Smith.

glosses: To join or connect. See also marry up.

examples.text: There’s a big gap here. These two parts don’t marry properly.

glosses: To unite; to join together into a close union.

examples.text: The attempt to marry medieval plainsong with speed metal produced interesting results.
